title: Blush Framework menu
description: A site menu in user/data/menus/, shown by the theme location with the same name.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file with.

label.description: Names the navigation for screen readers. Defaults to the theme's name for the location.

menuItem.description: A menu item: one link (or none, for a heading over children) and its options. A theme may accept more keys.

collection.description: Links to a content type's listing, such as post. Its landing page's title is the label, if it has one.

entry.description: Links to an entry, as {type}/{key}, such as page/about; {type}/ is its landing page. Its title is the label.

route.description: Links to a named route, such as home.feed (bin/blush routes:list lists them). Needs a label.

term.description: Links to a taxonomy term's archive, as {taxonomy}/{slug}, such as category/art. Its title is the label.

url.description: Links to a URL, as written, such as https://example.org/ or /about. Needs a label.

label.description: The text shown. Needed for route and url links; for the others it replaces the title.

children.description: Items shown under this one. An item with children and no link is a heading for them.

icon.description: An icon shown with the label, such as house or mytheme/github.

description.description: A short line of text under the label, for larger dropdown menus.

image.description: The URL of a small image shown with the label.

badge.description: A short tag, such as New.

class.description: A CSS class for the item.

rel.description: The link's rel, such as me for your own profiles.

localeText.description: Text by locale, such as {"en": "About", "fr": "À propos"}.
